If you can find them, I recommend first watching the de-specialized versions of Ep. 4-6. When you watch Ep. 6, try your best to pretend that the Ewoks are an elite fighting force rather than a group of teddy bears. I wouldn't say the Ewoks ruin the movie, but as an adult it's really hard to overlook how ridiculous that part is.

Next, look for the fan edit of Ep. 1-3. I like "The Last Turn to the Dark Side". It re-cuts and condenses Ep. 1-3 into a single movie. There is a bunch of stuff in Ep. 1-3 that is boring, unnecessary, and nonsensical. It really detracts from what could have been a great story.
